text:
Highly recommended! A wonderful small family-run dental clinic in Bangkok, operating since 1982. Very kind, welcoming, and highly professional people. The whole experience was amazing from start to finish.

We came for a dental cleaning, professional check-up, and consultation, and even a tiny cavity on my front tooth was discovered and treated immediately. Impeccable work! The doctor truly has golden hands and stunning professional skills. . Everything was done with such precision, care, and high-quality standards.

What impressed us  — we simply walked in without an appointment and were treated right away. Such personal service is rare to find today.

Thank you for the excellent experience! You all are amazing! 🙏

This is probably the best dental clinic in Bangkok. They have good pricing, great staff. The dentist is also so gentle and sweet. Totally an inner child healing experience every time I go here. Got injected in my mouth, yet felt like I could fall asleep while she was working on my teeth ❤️ Definite recommendation!

I had an excellent experience at 66 Dental Clinic. The staff were incredibly friendly and professional, from the reception to the dentist. It’s a small clinic, but very clean and well-equipped, which makes the whole experience even more comfortable.

I went for a dental cleaning and paid around 1,200 baht, which is a very fair price considering there was quite a bit of work to do (I’m a smoker, so it was definitely needed). The dentist was very careful and thorough, and the result was perfect.

She also found a small cavity and treated it on the spot. The procedure was quick, precise, and completely painless. You can really tell they know what they’re doing.

Another great point is that they speak English very well, which makes communication very easy if you don’t speak Thai. The location is also super convenient — it’s only about a 10-minute walk from Khaosan Road, so it’s perfect for both tourists and locals.

I 100% recommend this clinic. Great quality, professionalism, friendly service, and fair prices. I’ll definitely return for future treatments.

The young, motivated, and cheerful dentist does an excellent job and speaks good English. We had a dental cleaning and a night guard made.
We booked the appointment via WhatsApp, and the night guard was ready within a week. Payment can be made in cash or by bank transfer.
Same-day appointments are sometimes possible, depending on availability.
Gladly again!

My dental filling broke while I was in vacation in Bangkok and my friend recommended that I have it fixed in Bangkok instead of flying back to the Philippines.  I saw most dentists here have good reviews so I went to one.  Unfortunately the other dental clinic was fully booked so the reception recommended to go to 66 Dental Clinic.

I had a very pleasant experience at 66 Dental clinic.  The dentist was very good and gentle since my pain tolerance is kinda low.  The cost was very affordable...she even gave me a discount.  Thank you so much 😀

I just got tooth extraction today, the doctor and staff is very kind and well-spoken. I didn't get any harm or feel hurt during pulling my teeth out.
If you got something to done with your dental, i really appreciate recommend this place. Professional plus not overpriced. 100/10 ✨
PS. Didn’t mean to shock you with my tooth that decided to cosplay as sleeping beauty 🛌🏽

Absolutely first class Dentist office. I chipped a front tooth the other night, looked up this office and walked in the next day. I waited about 15 minutes for a current patient to finish up and then went right in.
She is a fine Dentist, has all the modern equipment and speaks English perfectly!
She smoothed my tooth and I then opted for a teeth cleaning which she did right then!
Great service, great price and you feel you are with friends there. Her father is at the front desk and her sister assists her.
Very professional and efficient.

I came in for a teeth cleaning and was fortunate to find an available time slot.

The dentist was incredibly nice and helpful. She explained my teeth condition before the cleaning. Afterward, she suggested a few fillings for sensitive teeth, which I was able to get done without any stress. I completed one filling, and the result is fantastic. Thank you!

By the way, she speaks English fluently and was very friendly in recommending several places to visit afterward.

Got off the plane at Suvarnabhumi around 3pm, arrived in Bangkok old town around 6pm and walked straight into this clinic (upon prior ressearch) still carrying my luggage, and got a teeth cleaning appointment for half an hour later (6:30pm!!!!!) !!!
Excellent English, lovely female dentist, clean and professional - fantastic service and affordable!
I will definitely be back! Thank you!

I returned here for teeth cleaning after having whitening last year. Really excellent service, very friendly staff with great English communication. I normally pay privately in the UK and the service here is superior. Highly recommended

Never expected to have such a positive experience at a dentist's. Very professional,  perfect result, efficient, what more can I say....except 10% cost of an Aussie dentist.
Highly recommend 👍
Paul

seriously i shocked why they changed me when they refused fix my tooth.

My boys were a little nervous about the visit, but she immediately put them at ease. They actually enjoyed the experience! Not only is she great with kids, but her services are also very affordable. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a friendly and skilled dentist!

text: Happened to chance upon 66 Dental Clinic. Went for a consultation with Dr. Poon and team, had a teeth cleaning and tooth filing session. Price is reasonable and explained clearly before the commencement of the session. Dr Poon and team was gentle and friendly throughout the whole session, did not feel any pain at all. Dr. was able to converse clearly with english. Well recommended, will visit again.
I had a super pleasant experience, the doctor was very attentive to everything, I had the best time, no complaints, the place was super nice and clean, I would definitely visit again

It was quite good. The attention was good and fast. The dentist speaks very good English so there are no problems for foreigners. They are honest and will tell you if you need to go to a hospital for a dental treatment in case they don't have the necessary implements for a specific treatment.

Prices are affordable for any treatment. It is worth going there.
Only 4 stars because you will need to go to another place for treatment if you have an extremely serious o very specific dental problem.

My visit was over an hour later than the scheduled appointment. I had read that healthcare in Thailand, especially in Bangkok, is of a high standard—similar to Europe—while being more affordable. Unfortunately, I ended up spending quite a lot. Perhaps this is because it's one of the few places where the staff speaks good English. The treatment was more preventive and painless. However, after the visit, the teeth treated were very painful for over a month. I emailed them about it, and they asked me to come in, but by that time, I was no longer in the area. I flew to Laos and then to northern Thailand. A few weeks later, all the fillings done at this clinic began to fall out. I wanted to see another dentist and asked if 66-Dental Clinic would cover the costs of fixing what went wrong, provided I send them a doctor's certificate, but I received no response. It seems they ignored me. I do not recommend this clinic!
Excellent service I just finished my cleaning and she did a great job, very professional I highly recommend it

I came here for a scale and polish. The lady dentist was very thorough and it was one of the more gentle procedures that I have had. She gave feedback on my teeth and fillings in particular, but was not pushing for additional treatment. She also spoke excellent English. 100% recommend if you need dental treatment in Bangkok.

I have visited twice, both for cleaning and cavity filling. Brilliant, careful dentistry procedures by the doctor who took the time to explain each stage. Very professional clinic offering a wide range of tooth cleaning and care. Excellent!

I recently had a tooth filling for cavities, and I couldn't be more pleased with the service. The doctor was incredibly polite and friendly, making the entire experience comfortable and stress-free. Their professionalism and attention to …
Jenny is a great dentist. I popped in for a teeth clean. I am really happy with the speed and quality of the work. The service is excellent and the price is very fair. 100% recommend :)

Wow, my first time at the dentist in 30 years! I was ready for disaster—maybe some screaming, a few pulled teeth, and a lifetime ban from the clinic. But nope! It was actually amazing. So amazing that I might willingly go back. Thank you so much for the loveley experience

Highly Recommend 66-Dental Clinic
I had a very positive experience at 66-Dental Clinic. Booking an appointment was straightforward, the clinic itself was clean and professional, and the prices were fair. The family-owned atmosphere made me feel welcome and comfortable. Overall, I highly recommend 66-Dental Clinic for anyone seeking dental care in Bangkok.

I have just finished a round of treatment here and I cannot rate these guys enough. I visited previously just for small work eg fillings and was very happy with service and price. This time it was to get major dental work done. Because of my previous visits I felt confident to trust 66 to do an awesome job.  A whole new top row of  crowns, whitening lower teeth, and a couple of fillings. I cannot be happier with the results ( to the point I cried when shown my new teeth). All staff from reception to Dr are amazing, kind and friendly. Would not hesitate to recommend to anyone. Thank you so much for my new  smile☺

The service was very good. Dentist Poon's equipment was also in perfect condition.
She could speak fluent English, allowing easy communication and a very fun time.
Dentist Poon also understood my request very well and had very gentle hands when operating.😊

We‘ve been there because my husband had some problems with his wisdom tooth. The team from 66-Dental Clinic is really friendly and the prices are fair. What we really appreciate is that they spoke English and made honest recommendations without selling us more than we want right now. I can really recommend the Dental Clinic!

Came here to get my teeth cleaned. Was a bit nervous since I have upper and lower retainers plus I’m quite scared of pain. The dentist did an excellent job gently removing all tartar and polishing my teeth. A pain free experience and well worth the money. I’ll come here again.

I managed to break one of the wires for my fixed retainer during my trip. I wasn't really sure where to go having never visited a dentist in Thailand before. The reviews for this clinic and the fact it was near my hotel is what made me ultimately decide to stop by. Thankfully removing the broken wire from my retainer ended up being a quick and easy fix. The price was pretty reasonable too. I'd definitely recommend this clinic if you find yourself nearby and in need of any dental work during your Thailand trip.

I went there for scaling. The price depends on the condition of your teeth. The doctor was very nice. After only half an hour she was done (at home they take a full hour to do it). The cleaning was not totally accurate. At the hotel, with a smaller mirror, I recognised that there were still some spots left not really cleaned.

The best dentist I have ever been too and really cheap. Kind and compassionate. Would highly recommend to any tourist in Bangkok.Had a molar extracted and was not painful in any way. Even received dressing and pain medication to take home. Well worths the trip from Sydney to save $300.
